messages.content: Do I have to use Pageup , PageDown or the Up arrow Down arrow afrter the ctrl key
No — for this Snake game, you do not use Page Up / Page Down. Use only the regular arrow keys. Up Arrow, Down Arrow, Left Arrow, Right Arrow.
please verify the code again ,still the keys are not connected
I checked the file and the arrow-key logic itself is correct. The likely issue is focus/input behavior, not the code logic.
Im using regular keyboard
Yes — regular keyboard arrow keys are the correct keys. No Ctrl is needed. The issue is likely focus/input behavior rather than wrong key mapping.
Lets design bit more.. Snake can be more realistic and the food is realistic..The speed can slow down
Updated the design idea to a slower speed, realistic snake body/head, and realistic apple-style food.
Now change the snake into different color. After the game is over ask user to continue for next game or close it with simple Yes No
Updated the game to use a purple snake, and added a simple Y/N replay prompt after game over.
Let's have a intro for the game , ready set go ..After the click game can start .. Next , set the Levels 1,2,3 with lower speed to highest...
Added an intro screen with Ready, Set, Go!, level selection (1, 2, 3), and different speeds from slow to fast.
The initial intro should inform player to move the Up DOwn keys... please change font..it should be fancy and real like game
Updated the intro to include arrow-key instructions and more arcade-style fonts.
Level inside the box not justified right, make the initial screen with animated. Everytime the food should be random for the snake...  Next allow player to choose the color of the snake
Adjusted the intro to an animated layout, centered the level selector, made food random on each spawn, and enabled snake color selection before starting.
I see the food is still the same apple , can we pass random food within levels?
Yes — updated the game so each level has random food types such as apple, berry, orange, grape, golden apple, and star fruit.
copy the chat as jason file
Created a JSON export file for this chat conversation, stored in the repository.
